dedupe_keys.name: detailed database of tall pre northridge steel moment frames for earthquake performance evaluations

description: Detailed Database of Tall Pre-Northridge Steel Moment Frames for Earthquake Performance Evaluations is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Francisco Galvis, Stanford University (stanford.edu). This projects presents a detailed database of 89 tall steel moment frame buildings representative of the construction practices in the western U.S. before the 1994 Northridge earthquake. This database contains all details that affect the structural performance of steel moment frames, including frame geometry in both directions, member cross-section sizes, and gravity system characteristics. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-wjad-r340. Keywords: Tall buildings, Welded steel moment frames, fracture. Published 2024-01-16. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
